title: Chapter 44 World Selection
content:
Chapter 44 World Selection

"The host chooses the world, it is being extracted, please wait"

"After the extraction is complete, the worlds to choose from include "Looking for the Qin Dynasty", "The Legend of Double Dragon of the Tang Dynasty", "New Three Kingdoms", "Xiao Li Feidao" and "Water Margin". Please enter and choose a world from which to travel."

Without making Zhong Yu wait too long, the system has selected all the worlds.

There are five worlds for each choice, and I only need to pick the most suitable one from the five words.

So, which world should you choose?

The Legend of the Double Dragon of the Tang Dynasty, it is a world where the sky is full of innateness, there are as many masters as dogs, only the great masters can shake, and there is not a world without broken voids.

Xiantian is already at the third level; Grandmaster, the third level is about to enter the fourth level of existence; Grand Master, the fourth level of existence; Broken Void, has entered the fifth level.

This is a world where the strength is beyond the charts. With my current highest level of second rank and the strength of a small number of people, I ran into it, and I would rush to the street every minute!

Xiao Li Feidao, the highest strength in it is not strong, that is, a group of third-order existences, at most close to the fourth-order existence. But this world has a characteristic that strength does not mean everything.

There is a thing called poison that threatens all the strong. There is also something called intrigue, which dominates the fate of all people.

If a simple-minded person like myself ran in, it would be very easy for people to take his precious life away. It's too dangerous, don't take it yourself.

Then there are only Xunqin, Water Margin, and Three Kingdoms left. The people in these three worlds don't have any extraordinary powers. At most, they can resist dozens of people by virtue of their talents. They are not a big threat to their own army, and they can mix in them. have to go down.

Then let yourself take a look, Xun Qin Ji, this is not good, when it is inside, the princes and kingdoms have not yet perished, and they are in a world of great controversy.

The entire Warring States period was the time when the war mobilization system was the most perfect in ancient Chinese history.

Don't you see, every country has hundreds of thousands of troops going out every now and then. Then after a war, hundreds of thousands and hundreds of thousands will die casually.

But after a year or two, or even a few months, this number of soldiers and horses came out again, and I had hundreds of thousands of people thrown into this kind of place, and not even a single one would come out.

Then only the Water Margin and the Three Kingdoms are left. The power of the Great Song Dynasty in the Water Margin is relatively weak, and all kinds of armaments have been corrupted to the extreme. It can be said that they can be broken with a single poke, and they cannot provide any support for the Great Song Dynasty.

However, this world has a characteristic, that is, there are many countries other than the Song Dynasty, and the military equipment of each country is very strong, and it is extremely prosperous, just like the world of the Warring States Period.

Dali, Tubo, Xixia, Daliao, Koryo, Japan, the countries of the Western Regions, and Jiaozhi all have their own systems and countries.

And every country can at least have hundreds of thousands of troops. For a military power like Tubo, Xixia and Daliao, it can even come up with hundreds of thousands of troops.

My Da Song himself, although he is bad, but he also has millions of troops on the surface, and he wants to kill all those millions of pigs, and it is not possible for hundreds of thousands of people to do this things.

Like the Jurchens who have risen in the past few years, the reason why they were able to complete the great cause of overthrowing the Daliao and Song Dynasties was based on the fact that he had two to three hundred thousand Jurchen cavalry.

In the end, the Liao Kingdom, with a small population in the whole country, was overthrown, while the Song Kingdom, with a population of tens of millions, fell into a quagmire and was overwhelmed by population tactics.

So, want to rule the majority of the population with the minority. The strength foundation of one's own side must reach a certain level, otherwise it is just a fantasy.

In this world, there are powerful countries all around, and there are tens of millions of soldiers. People like me can't play around, so let's give up!

Then you can only choose the Three Kingdoms. The Three Kingdoms are in troubled times, and the princes are rising together. There are no powerful barbarians around, they are all in the tribal era, and not even a small country has been established.

And the Han Dynasty is in the last days of the dynasty. Although the army is very powerful, there are also internal conflicts, and it is impossible to concentrate its strength. I have a period of time to buffer.

The prelude to the Three Kingdoms was initiated by the Yellow Turban Uprising. It took him a year to put down the Yellow Turban Uprising in the Eastern Han Dynasty with the power of the whole country.

I can just take this period of time, and then raise troops in the land of Bashu, take advantage of the blocked roads and steep passes, control the pass, and block the connection between Bashu and the imperial court, and I can do whatever I want in it.

As long as I can control Hanzhong County within a year, before the Han Dynasty pacifies the Yellow Turban.

Most of the connection between the imperial court and Bashu is through the ancient Hanzhong Road, through the roads built by King Qin Huiwen. As long as he occupies Hanzhong County, the road traffic between Bashu and the imperial court will be under his control.

I can also follow the example of Yizhou Mu Liu Yan of the Three Kingdoms, who used the excuse of Hanzhong's five buckets of rice to rebel, instead of paying tribute to the court, and closed the door to call himself the emperor.

And when the Han Dynasty put down the Yellow Turban Uprising, they wanted to attack themselves. But he will find that the Qiang uprising in Xiliang suddenly broke out in his entire Liangzhou Guanzhong.

The entire Qiang nationality united with the Han people in Liangzhou to rebel together. The uprising led by Beigong Boyu, Bian Zhang, Han Sui, and Ma Teng will implicate the entire Han Dynasty.

Until the death of Emperor Han Ling, he couldn't calm down. He could only rely on Dong Zhuo's appeasement and use most of Liangzhou as a price to make those people surrender to him on the surface.

And I will also usher in a safe time of up to four years. I believe that with the help of the system, such a long time is enough for me to unify the entire Bashu land.

At that time, the princes had just asked for Dong, but they themselves owned Liu Bei's foundation in the late Three Kingdoms period.

Even Liu Bei can't compare to himself, because his own Bashu population is larger, all kinds of damage have not reached the worst level, and all facilities are relatively complete.

Most of the other heroes only have one or two sentences, and there are only a few thousand soldiers and horses, and there are tens of thousands more. When the time comes, I will raise hundreds of thousands of troops and fight everywhere. Who can stop my footsteps!

Then it is such a happy decision, just choose the Three Kingdoms.

"System, I choose the world of "New Three Kingdoms"."

"The selection of the world is completed, and it is confirmed as the world of "New Three Kingdoms". Please host to decide whether to go immediately or delay, but please decide within one year."

Is that really the case? When to go is your own choice, as long as you decide within one year. This service is really humanized, but I like it.

"Put it off, I'm not ready yet, I'll go again after a while."

After speaking to the system, Zhong Yu turned his head and began to think about how to spend the 1000 luck points he just got. These luck points can be exchanged for population, you can get 10,000 people, and you can exchange them for the army, which can be exchanged for 2,000 ordinary troops.

How to use it reasonably is up to you.

If you want to attack the Three Kingdoms, you must have sufficient troops and talent reserves. Cao Cao, Sun Quan, Liu Bei, those monarchs, no matter what they do, why are they restrained by their subordinates everywhere?

Isn't it because of the aristocratic families represented by those subordinates, what do those aristocratic families represent? It represents the will of the lowest township pavilion in the entire Han Dynasty.

They controlled the entire countryside, and the imperial power did not go to the countryside. Therefore, those monarchs must respect their opinions. These big clans can easily attract hundreds or thousands of other people.

If they all rebel together, it is definitely not something they can bear.
